description: This file defines the IconPackManager class, which manages icon pack plugins in Drupal, including validation, discovery, and configuration of icon packs.

classes.name: IconPackManager
classes.description: Manages icon pack plugins, including validation, discovery, and configuration in Drupal.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Sets the JSON schema validator service if available.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Processes and validates an icon pack definition, adding path info and icons.

methods.name: getIcons
methods.description: Retrieves all icons, optionally filtered by allowed icon packs.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves a specific icon definition by full ID.

methods.name: getExtractorFormDefaults
methods.description: Gets default form values for a specific icon pack.

methods.name: getExtractorPluginForms
methods.description: Builds configuration forms for icon extractors.

methods.name: listIconPackOptions
methods.description: Lists available icon packs with optional descriptions.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Provides the discovery object for icon pack YAML files.

methods.name: providerExists
methods.description: Checks if a provider module or theme exists.

methods.name: getIconsFromDefinition
methods.description: Discovers icons from a definition's extractor.

methods.name: validateDefinition
methods.description: Validates an icon pack definition against a JSON schema.
